modules.module_title: Prepare and maintain work area for chilling of milk

pcs.pc_description: clean and maintain the cleanliness of the work area using approved cleaning chemicals and sanitizers to keep it free from dust, waste, flies and pests
ensure that the work area is safe and hygienic for the chilling of milk
dispose of waste materials as per defined SOPs and industry requirements
receive milk at the chilling plant in milk cans
prepare milk reception schedule for all the routes without loss of quality
plan the route of the milk van in such a way that the procured milk reaches the chilling plant at the specified time for that route
use ice packs or portable chilling units for the cooling of milk cans during transit and before the reception at the CC

check the working and performance of all equipment used in chilling plant facility such as compressor, conveyor belt, condenser, evaporator, fans, sensors, thermostatic expansion valve, humidity meter, etc.
clean the equipment used with approved cleaning chemicals and sanitizers following SOP
ensure that the oil traps on the refrigerant discharge side are frequently drained
check evaporators and receivers if it has solidified and is obstructing the flow of the refrigerant
ensure that the evaporator coils are kept free of frost by periodically defrosting
ensure that the refrigerant pipes are free of any clog and there is no ice inside the pipes
ensure that the compressor stuffing boxes are repacked at regular intervals
practice minor repairs/faults of all equipment, if required

modules.module_title: Ensure proper installation of the chilling unit

pcs.pc_description: inspect the location for setting up the chilling unit, install condensing unit, mount evaporation coil evaporator
install piping following industry guidelines and applicable codes to ensure proper operation of the unit, check all wiring connections
calculate the number of temperature sensors required for the unit, identify the location to place the sensors and place them in relevant locations
charge refrigerant from the supply tank to compressor determining charging level through weight and sight glass indication
practice pre-start-up checks by verifying sufficient refrigerant is charged, electrical connections are tight, wiring and piping are properly routed and secured
calibrate various measuring and controlling instruments like HP/LP cutouts, o/l relays, temperature sensors, thermostatic expansion valve
start the system and check the compressor discharge and suction pressures to ensure they are in the normal operating range
check the voltage and amperage at the compressor terminals
check fans on the evaporator coil and condensing unit (for air-cooled condenser) to ensure they are operational and turning in the correct direction
set up the defrost control/timer clock to the required time and verify the defrost initiation settings, set the temperature control to desired temperature range
check the functioning and performance of sensors and temperature measuring devices
check all the features of the unit, operation of the cooling equipment and ensure readiness
calibrate temperature and humidity measuring instruments of the facility
receive milk for chilling in cans, check the quality of milk to be refrigerated through physical parameters such as appearance and smell
arrange cans on the conveyor belt by type of milk and supplier
adjust controls to set storage parameters such as temperature and humidity required for the milk to be chilled down to the specified temperature, following the storage parameter chart
ensure that the milk from the cans/containers is emptied into a weighing bowl with a filter where the weight of the milk can be measured through an electronic weighing machine
check the temperature of milk following SOP
pump the milk from the holding tank through the line filter
ensure that the milk is passed through the PHE for cooling
observe temperature and humidity and adjusts controls to maintain storage parameters during the entire chilling period
check the temperature of stored milk periodically for conformance to set and achieved temperature
ensure that milk storage tanks are properly cleaned
store chilled milk in silos or directly pumped into milk tanker for transportation
test the milk for Fat/ SNF temperature, any impurities before final transportation to the processing unit
take the sample from the weighing bowl and test the milk for fat, SNF, acidity and adulterants
collect and send samples from all batches (VLCs) of milk received to the chilling plant laboratory
mark/number the samples collected
analyze milk samples for Fat and SNF content, acidity and adulteration
conduct various milk tests for adulterants and segregate cans accordingly

modules.module_title: Inspect, repair/replace chilling systems and components

pcs.pc_description: conduct periodic inspection of system and components for correct operation
identify malfunction of components, dismantle, repair and replace faulty components
reassemble components, test for correct operation, charge system with correct refrigerant, ensure the correct operation of the equipment
ensure equipment is running efficiently and the required operating conditions are maintained in the chilling containers for operational requirements

modules.module_title: Maintain the chilling system and components

pcs.pc_description: ensure periodic preventive maintenance of the system and components following SOP
check the evaporators for ice accumulation/proper defrosting, wash evaporator coils to remove dust and foreign materials drawn into the fins
check evaporator and condenser fan blades for fractures, clean the fan blades, replace worn blades and tighten the fan set screws, lubricate fan motors, replace fan motor if required

check for the operation of defrost controls, ensure defrost heaters are in the correct position for maximum heat transfer to the evaporator coil, check the voltage at each heater terminal and ensure heater terminals are in good condition
replace worn condenser motor in compressor unit
check all electrical components and replace damaged wirings and tighten all electrical connections
check and ensure the functioning of pressure controls and safety controls
check the oil level, ensure the working of solenoid valves
clean condenser periodically
check the condition of refrigerant line insulation and replace if necessary, check the refrigerant level in the system, ensure no refrigerant leak
follow safety protocols for handling ammonia- based refrigerants

modules.module_title: Hygiene and sanitation related functions for storage of milk in a chilling plant

pcs.pc_description: comply with sanitation and hygiene procedures followed in the organization
ensure personal hygiene by using gloves, hairnets, masks, earplugs, goggles, shoes, etc.
ensure hygienic storage of milk by inspecting raw materials, ingredients, finished products, etc. for compliance to physical, chemical and microbiological parameters
clean, maintain and monitor milk processing equipment periodically, using it only for the specified purpose
follow housekeeping practices by having a designated area for materials/tools
provide training on hazard management to understand types of hazards such as physical, chemical and biological hazards
conduct workplace checklist audits before and after work to ensure safety and hygiene
document and maintain procured milk, storage container or packaging material, process and finished milk and milk products for the credibility and effectiveness of the food safety control system

modules.module_title: Apply safety practices for storage of milk in a chilling plant

pcs.pc_description: comply with safety procedures followed in the organization
judge the quality of produce using criteria such as smell, appearance, taste and take immediate measures to prevent spoilage
store different varieties of produce, chemicals, gases separately to prevent cross- contamination
label produce, chemicals, gases in both local and English language and store them in designated storage areas
